kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
استهللت (form X)
# اِسْتَهْلَلْتُ (istahlaltu) /is.tah.lal.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِسْتَهَلَّ (istahalla)
# اِسْتَهْلَلْتَ (istahlalta) /is.tah.lal.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِسْتَهَلَّ (istahalla)
# اِسْتَهْلَلْتِ (istahlalti) /is.tah.lal.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِسْتَهَلَّ (istahalla)
# اُسْتُهْلِلْتُ (ustuhliltu) /us.tuh.
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
